question: List every basketball league we track.
sql: SELECT l.code, l.name FROM sports.leagues AS l WHERE l.sport = 'basketball' ORDER BY l.code LIMIT 10

question: How many teams are in each league?
sql: SELECT l.code, COUNT(t.code) AS team_count FROM sports.leagues AS l LEFT JOIN sports.teams AS t ON t.league_code = l.code GROUP BY l.code ORDER BY l.code LIMIT 10

question: Show all teams with their conference and division.
sql: SELECT t.code, t.name, t.conference, t.division FROM sports.teams AS t JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = t.league_code WHERE l.sport = 'basketball' ORDER BY t.name LIMIT 30

question: Which teams hosted a game in the 2025-26 season?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM sports.games AS g JOIN sports.teams AS t ON t.league_code = g.league_code AND t.code = g.home_team_code JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = g.league_code WHERE l.sport = 'basketball' AND g.season = '2025-26' ORDER BY t.name LIMIT 30

question: Who are the top 10 point scorers of the 2025-26 season?
sql: SELECT p.full_name, SUM(s.stat_value) AS total_points FROM sports.player_stats AS s JOIN sports.games AS g ON g.league_code = s.league_code AND g.game_code = s.game_code JOIN sports.players AS p ON p.league_code = s.league_code AND p.code = s.player_code WHERE s.stat_name = 'points' AND g.season = '2025-26' GROUP BY p.full_name ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 10

question: List the top 5 assist leaders of the 2026-spring season.
sql: SELECT p.full_name, SUM(s.stat_value) AS total_assists FROM sports.player_stats AS s JOIN sports.games AS g ON g.league_code = s.league_code AND g.game_code = s.game_code JOIN sports.players AS p ON p.league_code = s.league_code AND p.code = s.player_code WHERE s.stat_name = 'assists' AND g.season = '2026-spring' GROUP BY p.full_name ORDER BY total_assists DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was the average combined score per game in each season?
sql: SELECT g.season, ROUND(AVG(g.home_score + g.away_score), 2) AS avg_combined_points FROM sports.games AS g WHERE g.status = 'final' GROUP BY g.season ORDER BY g.season LIMIT 8

question: Show me the most recent final games with both team names.
sql: SELECT g.game_code, th.name AS home_team, ta.name AS away_team, g.home_score, g.away_score FROM sports.games AS g JOIN sports.teams AS th ON th.league_code = g.league_code AND th.code = g.home_team_code JOIN sports.teams AS ta ON ta.league_code = g.league_code AND ta.code = g.away_team_code WHERE g.status = 'final' ORDER BY g.starts_at DESC LIMIT 20

question: Which home teams won the most games?
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS home_wins FROM sports.games AS g JOIN sports.teams AS t ON t.league_code = g.league_code AND t.code = g.home_team_code WHERE g.status = 'final' AND g.home_score > g.away_score GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY home_wins DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which games had the biggest score margins?
sql: SELECT g.game_code, g.home_score, g.away_score, ABS(g.home_score - g.away_score) AS margin FROM sports.games AS g WHERE g.status = 'final' ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many games are there per status?
sql: SELECT g.status, COUNT(*) AS game_count FROM sports.games AS g GROUP BY g.status ORDER BY game_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which games start in the next seven days?
sql: SELECT g.game_code, g.season, g.starts_at, g.venue FROM sports.games AS g WHERE g.starts_at >= now() AND g.starts_at < now() + INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY g.starts_at LIMIT 50

question: Which games have no venue assigned?
sql: SELECT g.game_code, g.season, g.starts_at FROM sports.games AS g WHERE g.venue IS NULL ORDER BY g.starts_at LIMIT 20

question: Which basketball players are currently free agents?
sql: SELECT p.code, p.full_name, p.position FROM sports.players AS p JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = p.league_code WHERE l.sport = 'basketball' AND p.team_code IS NULL AND p.active = TRUE ORDER BY p.full_name LIMIT 20

question: Pivot the stat columns for every player across all their games.
sql: SELECT s.player_code, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'points' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS points, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'rebounds' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS rebounds, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'assists' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS assists FROM sports.player_stats AS s GROUP BY s.player_code ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which players have the highest combined points and rebounds totals?
sql: SELECT s.player_code, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'points' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'rebounds' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS total FROM sports.player_stats AS s GROUP BY s.player_code ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

question: Rank all players by their total points with ranks.
sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT s.player_code, SUM(s.stat_value) AS total_points FROM sports.player_stats AS s WHERE s.stat_name = 'points' GROUP BY s.player_code) SELECT totals.player_code, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY totals.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM totals ORDER BY points_rank LIMIT 20

question: List every esports league we track.
sql: SELECT l.code, l.name FROM sports.leagues AS l WHERE l.sport = 'esports' ORDER BY l.code LIMIT 10

question: Which LoL players had the most kills in the 2026-spring split?
sql: SELECT p.full_name, SUM(s.stat_value) AS total_kills FROM sports.player_stats AS s JOIN sports.games AS g ON g.league_code = s.league_code AND g.game_code = s.game_code JOIN sports.players AS p ON p.league_code = s.league_code AND p.code = s.player_code WHERE s.stat_name = 'kills' AND g.season = '2026-spring' GROUP BY p.full_name ORDER BY total_kills DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which players have the best kills to deaths ratio?
sql: SELECT p.full_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'kills' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'deaths' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS kd_ratio FROM sports.player_stats AS s JOIN sports.players AS p ON p.league_code = s.league_code AND p.code = s.player_code WHERE s.stat_name IN ('kills', 'deaths') GROUP BY p.full_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_name = 'deaths' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY kd_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many esports matches happened in each season?
sql: SELECT g.season, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM sports.games AS g JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = g.league_code WHERE l.sport = 'esports' GROUP BY g.season ORDER BY g.season LIMIT 20

question: How many synthetic teams are tracked?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM sports.teams AS t JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = t.league_code WHERE l.sport = 'synthetic' LIMIT 1

question: Give me a sample of five synthetic games.
sql: SELECT g.game_code, g.season, g.starts_at, g.status FROM sports.games AS g JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = g.league_code WHERE l.sport = 'synthetic' ORDER BY g.starts_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which stat names exist and how often do they appear?
sql: SELECT s.stat_name, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM sports.player_stats AS s WHERE s.stat_name IN ('points', 'rebounds', 'assists', 'kills', 'deaths') GROUP BY s.stat_name ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many stat rows does each league have?
sql: SELECT l.code, COUNT(s.game_code) AS stat_rows FROM sports.player_stats AS s JOIN sports.leagues AS l ON l.code = s.league_code GROUP BY l.code ORDER BY stat_rows DESC LIMIT 10

question: List every league, its sport, and its name.
sql: SELECT l.code, l.sport, l.name FROM sports.leagues AS l ORDER BY l.code LIMIT 20

question: Which leagues have no teams yet?
sql: SELECT l.code, l.sport FROM sports.leagues AS l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sports.teams AS t WHERE t.league_code = l.code) ORDER BY l.code LIMIT 10

question: Which teams were updated most recently?
sql: SELECT t.code, t.name, t.league_code, t.updated_at FROM sports.teams AS t ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT 10
